scripts.check:blueprint: npm run check:hygiene && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.check:web: npm --prefix apps/web run format:check && npm --prefix apps/web run check && npm --prefix apps/web test
scripts.check:workers: npm --prefix workers/issuance run check && npm --prefix workers/issuance test
scripts.check:contracts: forge fmt --root contracts --check && forge test --root contracts
scripts.check:evidence: cargo test --manifest-path proofs/Cargo.toml --locked -p ultratokenizer-pdf-evidence -p ultratokenizer-claim-evidence && cargo clippy --manifest-path proofs/Cargo.toml --locked -p ultratokenizer-pdf-evidence -p ultratokenizer-claim-evidence --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.check:parity: npm --prefix packages/domain run build && node proofs/tools/check-request-parity.mjs
scripts.check: npm run check:blueprint && npm run check:domain && npm run check:audit && npm run check:web && npm run check:workers
